<thought>Based on the observed electrospray mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z ≈ 121.05. This is consistent with the protonated molecular ion of a compound with a neutral monoisotopic mass around 120 Da. A common aromatic ketone that fits this mass is acetophenone (C₈H₈O, exact [M+H]⁺ = 121.0648 Da). Its formula and fragmentation pattern match the simple isotopic distribution seen (dominant M, low‑intensity M+1, negligible higher isotopes). Acetophenone is a plausible candidate for the sample, and its SMILES string is straightforward. Therefore, I submit the SMILES for acetophenone. </thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
